incidents.name: SATURN public setEnableSwitch()
incidents.notes: SATURN's setEnableSwitch(bool) is callable by anyone and disables the token's sell restrictions, letting the attacker bypass everyTimeSellLimitAmount and dump into the pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x9BDF251435cBC6774c7796632e9C80B233055b93 created 2024-04-22T07:14:18Z by 0xc8ce1ecdfb7be4c5a661deb6c1664ab98df3cd62, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xc468d9a3a5557bff457586438c130e3afbec2ff9; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). ~15 BNB x $582.91/BNB at the incident timestamp 1715008154 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $8,744.
